title: Page 8
slug: 娇妃要和离-风光-娘子人如其名温柔了时光款款向我走来-欸娘子别动手本郡王真不是故意成亲就失忆-谁能比她温柔倒楣郡王夫君成
content_zh:
「其实只是恰好此地我的生意多了点，要是换个地方可就没这么灵光。」崔静言收好了那价值连城的铁牌，居然还一脸遗憾。「比如南边的顺义县，因为有着营州左屯卫，卫指挥使是颖国公的侄子，颖国公府在那里有大片土地及店铺，相对的就限缩了我做生意的范围。」
他突然莫测高深地一笑，凑到她耳边低声道：「柔柔要不要帮我拓展一下顺义县的生意？」
「我要怎么帮你？」温柔反问，她可不觉得自己有这种天分。
「我们明日先赴杨家沟领兵，然后再到顺义……宰了颖国公的侄子可好？」他说得轻松惬意，彷佛在和妻子讨论明天吃猪肉还是羊肉那样自然。
温柔无言以对地看了他好半晌，最后终是被他正经八百的神情弄得忍俊不禁，笑了开来，「那你记得到时候得先把顺义二锅头的酿酒生意拿下，我爹可爱喝了……」
天坛设于京城外城南郊，其中轴偏东侧有大祀殿、皇穹宇及圜丘形成了一直线，当皇帝领百官往天坛祭祀时，会由正阳门出内城，直行从西侧进天坛。由于西侧空旷开阔，众人行入广场时便会不由自主生出一种对天地之雄伟的崇拜及对自身之渺小的反省。
每年皇帝亲诣天坛的祭礼有三，冬至时祭天，夏至时祭地，而孟春上辛日则是祈谷。
在祈谷这一日，帝王由宫中出行，大驾卤簿开道，京中文官四品、武官三品以上皆需陪祀，一行人浩浩荡荡的来到天坛，早在前一日就有太常寺派礼官前来摆好供品及祭物。
崔昊日身着十二章礼服，顶戴十二旒冕，在礼官的引导下慎重地进行祈谷仪式。百官立于坛下，战战兢兢地听着祷文，该跪就跪，该拜就拜。
来到最终献礼时，念祷词的神官突然七孔流血倒下，而正在敲的编钟礼器也整座倾倒，发出刺耳的金石交击声，祈祀仪式戛然而止，所有人都目瞪口呆地看着这一幕。
突然，站在百官前列的颖国公突然出列，说道：「还不护驾？」
于是原本护卫在天坛四周的仪卫们突然有一半抽出了刀剑，对准了崔昊日的方向。
这一点都不像护驾，反而像行刺了！
部分忠于帝王的官员及侍卫纷纷挡到崔昊日身前，将他护在内围，其他的官员则是站到了颖国公那方，双方隐隐对峙起来。
「颖国公，你此举意欲为何？」即使己方人少势弱，崔昊日也没有表现出一丝惊慌，反而相当沉稳地反问。
而他这番反应也让支持他的官员们默默增加了一点信心。
颖国公冷笑起来，大声说道：「帝王不孝，上天不悯，导致祭天仪式出了差错，礼官暴毙，礼器自损，臣以为陛下需心诚罪己，悔悟思过，反省自己还适不适合做一个天子……」
崔昊日面无表情地道：「你何不干脆要朕禅让算了？」
「帝王之位有德者居之，陛下若有此自知之明，臣亦是心悦诚服。」颖国公笑得更得意了，眼中骄矜完全不掩饰，看着崔昊日的神情彷佛亮晃晃的欣慰着这皇帝的上道。
「朕若禅让，要禅让给谁？」崔昊日正色盯着颖国公，实在看不过眼他的道貌岸然，直接将他的险恶图谋赤裸裸的撕开来。「朕无子嗣，太后也没有亲生子，诸王远离京城，如今明面上在京的亲王只有一个晋王，不过朕猜你敢在天坛公然谋反，宫里必然有接应你的人，说不定已经将晋王挟持甚至杀害，如此一来其他亲王鞭长莫及，谁敢出头？所以你废话连篇，说了一堆冠冕堂皇的理由，其实就是要朕禅让给你。」

崔昊日不屑地冷哼一声。「汝非皇室中人，就算当上皇帝，也只会在史书上被勾勒成勾结鞑子篡位的奸佞！」
指控对方勾结异族的话语一出，百官色变，颖国公更是铁青了脸。
「你怎么会……」知道这么多？颖国公一出口便知自己说错话，居然被崔昊日带着走，随即又圆了回来。「简直莫名其妙！」
不过一句口误已解释许多，不仅忠于皇帝的官员用痛恨的目光瞪他，连支持颖国公的官员们都纷纷露出奇怪的神情。
崔昊日很好心地说明，「太后专政多年，朕岂会不提防？你们在皇宫排除异己安插自己人，更换京城防卫，就是为了叛变做准备。可是北方威武侯领的大军忠于朕，随时可以回京勤王，你们便勾结鞑子，于冬季起兵，就是要将威武侯拖在北方，然后你们就可以公然谋反篡位！事成后你们再送几个城池给他们，算是条件的交换，你说朕说的对不对？」
今年鞑子起兵的确异常，经这么一说，众人哗然，一些站在颖国公身边的臣子甚至默默远离了几步，不愿再与之为伍。
他们或许是受制于颖国公，或许只是收受大笔贿赂，若颖国公只是窝里反便罢，有鞑子插手，他们这群人就成了卖国贼，遇到这种大是大非的情况，对民族家国的忠诚毕竟还是战胜了内心的弱点。
索性破罐子破摔，颖国公也不想再狡辩，哈哈大笑掩饰心虚。「成大事者不拘小节，待我成了君王，励精图治，创造盛世，功过自有后人评断……」
他话还没说完，天坛又有了异变，大祀殿面广十一间十二楹，内外两层围墙，皆在东南西北四面设有棂星门，其中南面的门都是三个石洞门。在大祀殿中气氛紧张时，一群来历不明的军队突然由四面棂星门齐齐涌入，反将颖国公的叛军包围住，而南面石洞门来的军队更是直接奔袭到了崔昊日一行人附近。
依附着皇帝的官员护卫们都竖起了全身寒毛，当下只觉天要亡我，其中突然有人叫出了声音，但这声音却是带着惊喜——
「大家看，这军队领兵的是宁化郡王，还有郡王妃！」
宁化郡王崔静言与皇帝交好，众人皆知；而郡王妃是威武侯之女温柔，领有军功军衔，更是将这支军队瞬间定调成了勤王军。
瞧那磅礡的气势还有壮盛的军容，他们知道，自己安全了。
众官当下感动得都要淌泪，本能的回头看了看崔昊日，尊贵的皇帝仍是处变不惊，眉毛都没动一下，足见勤王军的出现必是在他意料之中，而这平素才能不显的君王竟有这般谋略，众官越发喜悦，在内心欢呼着自己没有站错边！
待到崔静言及温柔成功地用杨家沟的军队将皇帝及众官护在身后，颖国公脸都绿了，指着崔静言夫妻的手都是抖的。
「宁化郡王！你……你竟豢养私军！」
崔静言还没说话，崔昊日的声音已经从后头透出来，「这是朕的军队！普天之下的军队都是朕的，朕要多养几军，由得你这逆臣废话？」
原本想帅上一把的崔静言忍不住暗地里翻个白眼，腹诽自家皇帝从兄还真会出锋头。
而对面的颖国公简直气得胡子都要翘起来，但眼下情势不由人，他似乎再怎么蹦躂也就这样了。这突然间的反转令颖国公一方的人都不安躁动起来，甚至有的人已经冲到皇帝阵营边跪下求原谅了。
颖国公知道这样下去不行，己方尚未成事，气势已被打落，更别说他们只是暂时看上去输了，他的叛变计划缜密，可不只有在天坛这方。

「陛下就算有私兵护着又如何？只能保你不死！但京城里留守的晋王现在应该已经枭首，太后只怕已取得了传国玉玺……」
content_en:
"Actually, I just happen to have a lot of business here. If I change to another place, I won't be so smart." Cui Jingyan put away the priceless iron plate with a look of regret on her face. "For example, Shunyi County in the south has Yingzhou Zuotun Guards. The commander of the guards is the nephew of Duke Ying. Duke Ying's mansion has a large area of land and shops there. This has relatively limited the scope of my business."
He suddenly smiled mysteriously and whispered into her ear: "Rourou, would you like to help me expand my business in Shunyi County?"
"How can I help you?" Wen Wen asked back. She didn't think she had such a talent.
"Tomorrow we will go to Yangjiagou to lead the troops, and then go to Shunyi... How about killing Duke Ying's nephew?" He said it in a relaxed and comfortable manner, as if he was discussing with his wife whether to eat pork or mutton tomorrow.
Gentle looked at him speechlessly for a long time, and finally she couldn't help laughing at his serious expression, and laughed, "Then you remember that you have to win down the brewing business in Erguotou, Shunyi first. My dad is so cute..."
The Temple of Heaven is located in the southern suburbs of the outer city of Beijing. On the east side of the axis, there is the Great Sacrifice Hall, the Imperial Vault and the Circular Mound, forming a straight line. When the emperor led hundreds of officials to worship at the Temple of Heaven, he would leave the inner city through Zhengyang Gate and go straight to the Temple of Heaven from the west. Due to the open space on the west side, when people walk into the square, they will involuntarily have a kind of worship of the majesty of heaven and earth and reflection on their own insignificance.
There are three sacrifices performed by the emperor in person at the Temple of Heaven every year: worshiping the sky during the winter solstice, worshiping the earth during the summer solstice, and praying for grain on the Xinth day of Mengchun.
On the day of praying for the valley, the emperor traveled from the palace and led the way. All civil servants of the fourth rank and military attachés of the third rank and above from Beijing were required to accompany him. The group came to the Temple of Heaven in great force. As early as the day before, Taichang Temple sent ceremony officials to arrange the offerings and sacrifices.
Cui Haori wore a twelve-chapter dress and twelve crowns. Under the guidance of the etiquette officer, he carefully performed the grain praying ceremony. All the officials stood under the altar, listening to the prayers with trepidation. They knelt down when they needed to, and worshiped when they needed to.
When it came to the final offering, the priest who was reciting the prayers suddenly fell down with blood from all seven holes, and the chime bell ceremony that was ringing also fell over completely, making a harsh sound of gold and stone clashing. The prayer ceremony came to an abrupt end, and everyone looked at this scene in stunned silence.
Suddenly, Duke Ying, who was standing in the front row of officials, suddenly came out and said, "You still don't want to escort me?"
So half of the ceremonial guards who were originally guarding the Temple of Heaven suddenly drew their swords and pointed them in Cui Haori's direction.
This doesn't look like an escort at all, but rather like an assassination!
Some officials and guards loyal to the emperor stepped in front of Cui Haori to protect him, while other officials stood on Duke Ying's side, and the two sides began to face off.
"Mr. Ying Guo, what is your intention with this move?" Even though his own side was small and weak, Cui Haori did not show a trace of panic. Instead, he asked calmly.
And his reaction quietly gave the officials who supported him a little more confidence.
Duke Ying sneered and said loudly: "The emperor is unfilial and God is not merciful. As a result, the ritual of offering sacrifices to heaven went wrong. The ceremony official died suddenly and the ritual vessels were damaged. I thought that your majesty needs to sincerely sin, repent and think about his mistakes, and reflect on whether he is still suitable to be an emperor..."
Cui Haori said expressionlessly: "Why don't you just ask me to give in?"
"The position of emperor is occupied by those who are virtuous. If your majesty has this self-knowledge, I will be sincerely convinced." Ying Guogong smiled even more proudly, the arrogance in his eyes was not concealed at all, and the expression on Cui Haori's face seemed to be bright and happy for the emperor's success.
"If I abdicate, to whom should I abdicate?" Cui Haori stared at Duke Ying sternly. He couldn't stand his sanctimony and directly tore apart his sinister plot. "I have no heirs, and the Queen Mother has no biological children. The kings are far away from the capital. Now there is only one prince in the capital, Prince Jin. But I guess if you dare to openly rebel in the Temple of Heaven, there must be someone in the palace to support you.Maybe the King of Jin has been kidnapped or even killed. If the other princes are out of reach, who dares to step forward? So you talk nonsense and give a bunch of high-sounding reasons, but in fact you just want me to give up to you. "
Cui Haori snorted disdainfully. "You are not a member of the royal family. Even if you become emperor, you will only be described in the history books as a traitor who colluded with the Tatars to usurp the throne!"
As soon as the words of accusing the other party of colluding with foreign races came out, the expressions of all the officials changed, and Duke Ying was even livid.
"How could you..." know so much? As soon as Ying Guogong said something, he knew that he had said the wrong thing, and was actually taken away by Cui Haori, and then he came back right away. "It's just baffling!"
However, a slip of the tongue explained a lot. Not only the officials loyal to the emperor glared at him with hatred, but also the officials who supported Duke Ying showed strange expressions.
Cui Haori explained very kindly, "The Queen Mother has been under dictatorship for many years. How can I not be careful? You eliminate dissidents in the palace and install your own people, and change the defense of the capital, just to prepare for rebellion. But the army led by the mighty princes in the north is loyal to me and can return at any time. King Jingqin, you colluded with the Tatars and raised troops in winter, just to drag Marquis Weiwu to the north, and then you can openly rebel and usurp the throne! After that, you will give them a few more cities in exchange for the conditions. Do you think I am right? "
It is indeed unusual for the Tatars to raise an army this year. After saying this, everyone was in an uproar. Some of the courtiers standing next to Duke Ying even silently took a few steps away, unwilling to associate with him anymore.
They may be under the control of Duke Ying, or they may just accept large bribes. If Duke Ying is just a rebel, and the Tatars intervene, they will become traitors. In such a situation of great right and wrong, their loyalty to the nation and country will eventually overcome their inner weakness.
Simply breaking the jar, Ying Guogong didn't want to quibble anymore and laughed to hide his guilt. "Those who achieve great things do not stick to trivial matters. When I become a king, I will work hard to govern and create a prosperous world. My merits and demerits will be judged by future generations..."
Before he finished speaking, another change occurred in the Temple of Heaven. The large sacrificial hall was eleven rooms and twelve couplets wide, with two layers of walls inside and outside. There were Lingxing gates on the southeast, northwest and four sides, including three stone cave gates on the south side. When the atmosphere in the Great Sacrifice Hall was tense, a group of unknown troops suddenly poured in from the four Lingxing gates and surrounded Duke Ying's rebels. The troops from the south Shidong gate rushed directly to Cui Haori and his party.
The officials and guards who were attached to the emperor all had chills all over their bodies. At that moment, they felt like the sky was going to kill me. Someone among them suddenly called out a voice, but the voice was filled with surprise——
"Look, everyone, this army is led by the Prince of Ninghua County and the Princess of Ninghua County!"
Everyone knows that Cui Jingyan, the prince of Ninghua County, is on good terms with the emperor; and the princess is gentle, the daughter of a mighty marquis, and has a military rank, which instantly transformed this army into King Qin's Army.
Looking at the majestic momentum and majestic military appearance, they knew that they were safe.
The officials were so moved that they shed tears. They instinctively looked back at Cui Haori. The noble emperor remained calm and didn't even move his eyebrows. This showed that the appearance of King Qin's army must have been expected by him, and that this king who usually showed no talent actually had such a strategy. The officials became more and more happy, cheering inwardly that they were not on the wrong side!
When Cui Jingyan and Wen Wen successfully used Yangjiagou's troops to protect the emperor and officials behind him, Duke Ying's face turned green, and his hands shaking when pointing at Cui Jingyan and his wife.
"Prince Ninghua! You...you actually support a private army!"
Before Cui Jingyan could speak, Cui Haori's voice had already come out from behind, "This is my army! All the armies in the world belong to me. How many more armies do I want to raise? Are you willing to talk nonsense like you, a rebellious minister?"
Cui Jingyan, who originally wanted to be handsome, couldn't help but roll her eyes secretly, slandering her emperor that Cong brother was really good at showing off.
The Duke Ying on the opposite side was so angry that his beard stood up.But the current situation is beyond our control, and it seems that no matter how much he bounces around, this is the end of it. This sudden reversal made everyone on Duke Ying's side restless and agitated, and some even rushed to the emperor's camp and knelt down to beg for forgiveness.
Duke Ying knew that this was not going to work. His side had not yet accomplished anything, and their momentum had been knocked down. Not to mention that they only seemed to have lost temporarily. His rebellion plan was meticulous, and it was not just at the Temple of Heaven.
"So what if your majesty is protected by private soldiers? I can only protect you from death! But the King of Jin who stayed behind in the capital should have taken over by now, and the Queen Mother may have obtained the imperial seal..."
